title: Surreal Cosmic Wanderer
description: A surreal painting features a large central orange and teal circular motif containing a stylized three-eyed crowned face. Below, a lone backpacker with antlers walks along a path through a red and black landscape toward distant mountains, surrounded by floating geometric line art and torn paper fragments displaying various abstract faces.
